_comment: The one list of the sbt modules in this repository. .github/scripts/check_modules.py (CI job 'Module registry check') fails if a file that hand-lists modules disagrees with it, naming the file and the line; to add a module, add it here first (dev/new-adapter does this for an adapter) and let the check say what else to edit. 'modules' is in dependency order. roles: engine (contract, ir, fingerprint, verification-core), kit (adapter-testkit), adapter (one per engine, spark-adapter first), harness (plugin, runner), extension (notification-kafka). 'published' modules go to Maven Central and run through the API-compatibility, coverage and release-dry-run loops; 'mutation' modules have a mutation-testing-<name> job in test.yml.
